description: Deterministic particle simulation of ARX_effects (spec/extensions/ARX_effects.md section 7). Seed = FNV-1a 32-bit of the effect id's UTF-8 bytes; one mulberry32 sequence per effect; each particle takes 10 draws in birth order: region x, y, z, cone cos(phi), cone alpha, speed, lifetime, size, first angle, angular speed. Births: continuous k / n; burst window w at w * (emitSeconds + pauseSeconds) with N = max(1, floor(emitSeconds * n + 0.5)) particles at j / n; n = rate * amount. A particle is alive when birth <= time < birth + lifetime; at most maxParticles live ones are kept, oldest (lowest index) first. Each expect row lists the live count and the particles at slots 0, 1, 2 and count - 1 of the live list in birth order: index (birth number), position (content-root space, target-width units), size, angleDegrees, color (sRGB 0..1), alpha. presetOverrides replaces fields of the named preset from schema/ext/ARX_effects.presets.json. An expect row with restart: true restarts the effect (spec 7.1, target tracked again) before advancing: the effect clock starts again at 0, so the row is a fresh simulation at its time. Compare every number with an absolute tolerance. Expected values come from tools/effects_reference.py.

cases.name: rise, turned emitter, particle 0 dies exactly at 3 s
burst, tilted emitter with gravity, two windows
snow, UTF-8 id, full amount, wide box
cap: 256 oldest live particles are kept
restart: burst found again plays window 0 again from T = 0
restart: a capped emitter refills from birth 0
constant alpha curve: alpha 1 from birth to death
float, mint stars: fixed 3 s life, particle 0 dies exactly at 3 s
